- When sentiment is consistently bullish (≥0.67) over recent days, model tends to overestimate prices; apply downward bias correction by 1–3% for 30d forecasts.
- After sharp price spikes (e.g., >+5% from prior period), model often overshoots and fails to correct; reduce forecast slope by 0.5–1.5% per day post-spike.
- If official event net supply is negative and bullish sentiment is low, model underestimates upside; add 1–2% upward bias to forecast mean.
- When sentiment is mixed or bearish (≤0.33) and supply net is negative, model underestimates downside; apply downward bias to forecast mean.
- For 30d forecasts, if true outcome deviates >5% from 14d moving average, adjust forecast to align with recent 14d trend (mean reversion heuristic).
- If multiple consecutive auctions (e.g., 3+ in 30d) are scheduled, model tends to overreact to supply shocks; dampen forecast slope by 0.5–1.0% per auction event.
